prompted_for: One statement between two sections (original of concept-p-band; became Band: one large sentence in a framed panel with a faint technical motif)
composition: framed panel with thin header and footer rules carrying previous/next section labels and centred logo
massive two-line navy headline across the left two-thirds
short two-line subline below the headline
fragment of a technical elevation drawing at right with data callout boxes
camera-style corner brackets framing the key word
mobile stacks headline in four lines over subline with drawing fragments behind
layout_devices: viewfinder corner brackets highlighting one word
outlined callout boxes with mono reference and deviation values
fragmentary pipe/elevation drawing at the edge
previous/next section labels in header and footer rules
palette: deep navy headline and line work
steel-blue corner brackets as the single accent
typography: very heavy condensed sans all-caps headline, tight leading
regular sans subline in sentence case
monospace small caps labels and figures with '//' separators
line_and_texture: 1 px navy frame and rules with slightly rounded corners
hairline elevation lines, small hatch marks
motion_implied: corner brackets snap in around the key word
drawing lines draw on behind the type
t2i_keywords: viewfinder corner brackets around one word
outlined callout boxes with monospace figures
desktop and mobile views side by side
t2i_prompt: Flat desktop UI mockup with a narrow mobile view beside it, no device frame, no people. Warm limestone off-white background, a thin navy-framed panel with hairline header and footer rules carrying small monospace previous and next section labels. One massive condensed deep-navy statement of <CONTENT> across the left two-thirds, with steel-blue viewfinder corner brackets around its key word and a short sentence-case subline below. At the right edge, a faint fragment of a technical elevation drawing with small outlined callout boxes of monospace figures. Generous whitespace, two colours plus one accent.
signature_idea: One huge statement set between sections, with viewfinder brackets locking onto the single word that matters.
strengths: a single clear sentence gives the page rhythm and a pause
limestone with navy and one steel-blue accent is on palette
viewfinder brackets are a memorable, reusable emphasis device
weaknesses: very heavy condensed caps is the opposite of Geist light headlines
the drawing fragment and random deviation figures are decorative and meaningless
brand_fit_why: Palette, single accent and space are on brand, but the black-weight condensed caps headline and invented figures clash with light Geist headlines and the no-hype voice.
